task.name: Strike_camp_arch
task.when: After 📋 Strike_camp_lighting passes and the Power Lead releases the arch

resources.resource: Build Lead and the crew count printed in 📦 Build_Book

step.action: Confirm that 📋 Strike_camp_lighting passed and the Power Lead released the arch structure.
Roll the clean, dry red carpet and secure it with a ratchet strap.
Lower the arch only on the Build Lead's command.
Dismantle the lowered arch in the printed reverse sequence.
Put every fastener and anchor in the arch hardware bin.
Pack the carpet and structural parts in their assigned transport group.

passWhen.criterion: The carpet, structure, fasteners, and anchors are accounted for and packed.
The former arch footprint is clear and MOOP-free.
